description: This file defines the ComposerInspector class, a PHP class within the Drupal package_manager module. It provides methods to interact with Composer, such as validating the environment, retrieving package info, and managing configuration, acting as a wrapper around Composer commands.

classes.name: ComposerInspector
classes.description: A PHP class that provides methods to interact with Composer, including validation, configuration retrieval, and package management within a Drupal environment.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger instance for the class and its callback.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that Composer commands can be run in the specified directory.

methods.name: validateProject
methods.description: Checks that composer.json is valid and composer.lock exists in the directory.

methods.name: validateExecutable
methods.description: Ensures that the Composer executable is available and of a supported version.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value from Composer for a given key and context.

methods.name: getInstalledPackagesList
methods.description: Returns a list of installed packages in a given directory.

methods.name: getPackageTypes
methods.description: Loads package types from the composer.lock file.

methods.name: getRootPackageInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the root package via `composer show --self`.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Retrieves installed package data by running `composer show`.

methods.name: invalidateCacheIfNeeded
methods.description: Invalidates cached package data if composer.json or composer.lock have changed.
